additional_sources_needed: The 2021-2029 Housing Element, Chapter 4, Appendices 4.1-4.3 (sites, projected units, lower-income units).
GCS 66499.41(a)(5). Chaptered text of the statute on leginfo.legislature.ca.gov. It cannot be captured as evidence until a statute source type exists; do not capture it as an adopted_ordinance.
candidate_pinpoint: Memo Part I, Minimum Density and Affordability Requirements for Housing Element Sites, pages 2-3
candidate_excerpt: Pursuant to GCS 66499.41(a)(5), all SHRA development projects proposed on sites identified in the City’s 2021-2029 Housing Element must result in at least the number of units projected for that parcel.
locate_in_source: Located in shra-2025-10-28: Part I, Minimum Density and Affordability Requirements for Housing Element Sites, pages 2-3, and FAQ Q.9, pages 15-16. Minimum density for other sites is page 3.
question_for_human_reviewer: The memo (pages 2-3, FAQ Q.9) treats Housing Element site status as a minimum-unit condition, not a bar: projects on Appendix 4.1-4.3 sites must reach the projected units, and a site projected for more units than proposed is ineligible. Do you agree that this criterion should become a controlled appendix classification that returns requires_judgment for a listed site and consistent_with_source for a reviewed not-listed site, and never a disqualifier without a proposed unit count? Should the Housing Element appendices or ZIMAS ZI-2512 be the record?

proposed_controlled_interpretation.controlled_values_required: housing-element-site-status becomes controlled: appendix_4_1 | appendix_4_2 | appendix_4_3 | not_listed, with projected units and lower-income units as numbers from the same record. A site only on the February 2025 rezoning list (CF 21-1230-S6) is not_listed for SHRA.
proposed_controlled_interpretation.narrowing_note: Convert the free-text status into the controlled appendix classification. The unit comparison needs a project fact and stays judgment.
proposed_controlled_interpretation.predicate_shape_if_reviewer_agrees: not_listed (reviewed) -> consistent_with_source; appendix_4_1, 4_2, or 4_3 -> requires_judgment (minimum units apply). Never disqualifying_per_source without a proposed unit count.
must_remain_unresolved_when: the status is free text, or absent from the appendices
the parcel is listed and the project's proposed unit count is unknown
the appendices and ZIMAS ZI-2512 disagree
proposed_controlled_interpretation.zimas_conflict_risk: Medium. The memo says Housing Element sites are noted in ZIMAS by ZI-2512 with projected units in the Housing tab (FAQ Q.9, page 15). The appendices are the underlying record; a difference stays a conflict.

candidate_components.label: Whether the parcel is an Appendix 4.1, 4.2, or 4.3 Housing Element site
candidate_components.pinpoint: Memo Part I, Minimum Density and Affordability Requirements for Housing Element Sites, pages 2-3

excerpts.text: Pursuant to GCS 66499.41(a)(5), all SHRA development projects proposed on sites identified in the City’s 2021-2029 Housing Element must result in at least the number of units projected for that parcel.
(i) Appendix 4.1 - Inventory of Adequate Sites, (ii) Appendix 4.2 - Public Development Pipeline Projects, and (iii) Appendix 4.3 - Private Development Pipeline Projects.
In particular, this SHRA requirement does not apply to the rezoning sites list adopted by the City Council in February 2025 (Council File 21-1230-S6).

new_facts_needed: housing-element-site-status as a controlled value (appendix_4_1 | appendix_4_2 | appendix_4_3 | not_listed).
candidate_components.controlled_value_encoding: Controlled appendix classification from the 2021-2029 Housing Element.
candidate_components.proposed_rule_if_reviewer_agrees: not_listed -> consistent_with_source (no Housing Element minimum; the non-Housing-Element minimum density still applies to the project). appendix_4_1, 4_2, or 4_3 -> requires_judgment (the project must reach the projected units and any lower-income units).
judgment_or_ambiguity: The memo notes this is not the LAMC Sec. 16.70 B Housing Element Sites list.
ZI-2512 in ZIMAS is a display of the appendices; it stays observation-only unless designated.

candidate_components.label: A listed site projected for more units than the project proposes is ineligible

excerpts.text: If a housing element site is projected to host more than the number of proposed units (including ADU/JADUs), that parcel is ineligible for SHRA streamlining.

new_facts_needed: A proposed unit count, which is a project fact the Program Screen does not hold.
candidate_components.controlled_value_encoding: Projected units round up (FAQ Q.9 and Q.24).
judgment_or_ambiguity: The bar compares the projection with the project's proposed units, so a parcel screen cannot decide it.
Lower-income RHNA units must also be met, with a 99-year restriction (page 16).

candidate_components.label: Minimum density for sites not listed in the Housing Element
candidate_components.pinpoint: Memo Part I, Minimum Density Requirements for Non-Housing Element Sites, page 3

excerpts.text: SHRA projects located on parcels not listed in the Housing Element appendices listed above are subject to the greater of the following minimum density requirements:

judgment_or_ambiguity: A project density condition (66% of zoning density or 20 units per acre), not a site bar.
